author: emartinez
quote: Disappointed in the Lack of a PC **** can you possibly skip the PC market in 2026? PC gaming is a massive part of the gaming industry, with millions of players ready and willing to buy GTA 6. Leaving PC players out of the picture is a huge disappointment, especially for a game of this scale and importance. It's not like PC gaming is some small, overlooked market anymore. The technology, audience, and demand are all there. Rockstar has the resources, experience, and money to make it happen. Nobody is asking for the impossible. Just give PC players the same opportunity to experience the game without having to wait months or potentially longer. It's 2026. Do better, Rockstar. PC gamers deserve to be part of the launch, too.
